answer: Score every identity by the entropy of its submission timing before any content is read. One controller driving a clone swarm fires them in a tight, synchronized spiral—intervals all cresting the same timing summit at once—so the detector folds that correlated cluster into one weight. Honest agents jitter on independent, human-noisy clocks, unrepeatable as the grain in jade. To escape it an attacker needs an isolated randomness source and scheduler per clone: 1000 fakes = 1000 separately-jittered clocks, no shared cron to amortize, and any shared timer leaks the correlation that unmasks them.
